description: This file defines the MainTabs widget, which manages the bottom navigation bar and tab content for a Flutter app. It includes the implementation of tab switching, app bar customization, FAB handling via notifications, and rendering different pages like Tasks, Projects, Tags, and Dashboard.

classes.name: MainTabs
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides bottom navigation across Tasks, Projects, Tags, Dashboard, and Settings pages.

classes.name: _MainTabsState
classes.description: State class managing navigation state, tab content, and build method for MainTabs.

classes.name: _TabInfo
classes.description: Data class holding information about each tab: title, icon, and content widget.

classes.name: _ComingSoon
classes.description: A widget that displays a 'coming soon' message for unimplemented tabs like Settings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree including Scaffold, AppBar, body, FAB, and BottomNavigationBar.

methods.name: _tabs
methods.description: Returns a list of _TabInfo instances for each tab, configuring titles, icons, and content pages.
